services.title: Start with a conversation.
services.intro: Most AI projects go wrong before a line of code is written — the wrong problem gets picked. So we start by finding the right one.

consultation.p2: A realistic scope: what it would take to build, roughly how long, and what could go wrong.
consultation.p3: A written summary after the call, so you can share it with your team without relying on your notes.

about.title: I'm Roya Vosoughi.
about.p1: I'm an AI engineer and software developer. I design and build applications powered by large language models — RAG systems, assistants and agents that take on a specific, measurable job inside a business.
about.p2: My focus is the gap between an impressive demo and a dependable product: answers grounded in your own data, sensible limits on what the AI decides alone, clear documentation, and support after handoff. Every project starts with your problem, not the technology.
about.quote: Built to be used, not just shown.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Roya Vosoughi — AI engineer and software developer building reliable LLM-powered applications, assistants and agents for businesses.
aboutPage.title: I turn large language models into tools businesses rely on.
aboutPage.lead: AI engineer and software developer. I design, build and support LLM-powered applications that do a specific, useful job — and keep doing it after handoff.
aboutPage.p1: My work is mostly applications powered by LLMs: retrieval systems that answer questions from a company's own documents, assistants that handle a repetitive task properly, and agents that know the limits of what they should decide alone.
aboutPage.p2: I have one rule that shapes everything: build in public. Every project is deployed, open source and documented. That is partly discipline — it is much harder to cut a corner when the repository is open — and partly the fastest way to show what I can do without asking anyone to take my word for it.
aboutPage.p3: I graduated from Politecnico di Torino in AI and Software Engineering.

punctual.name: Punctuality
punctual.body: The project arrives when I said it would. Your time is the one thing I cannot give back to you.

practical.name: Practicality
practical.body: A solution that works in the business, not a demo that works in a meeting.

creative.name: Creativity
creative.body: A specific answer to your specific problem, rather than last project's answer with the name changed.

inspiring.name: Possibility
inspiring.body: I want you to leave knowing what AI could do for you — including, honestly, when the answer is not much.

aboutPage.ctaBody: Tell me what the problem is. If I'm not the right person for it, I'll say so and point you somewhere better.
